167d0175d089a984.query: Does ShopSmart Electronics share my transaction records with tax authorities?
167d0175d089a984.reference_answer: Yes, ShopSmart Electronics shares transaction records with tax authorities to fulfill legal obligations.

b5b61309020abce1.query: What are the contact methods for ShopSmart Electronics' privacy team, security reports, and data protection officer?
b5b61309020abce1.reference_answer: You can contact the Privacy Team at privacy@shopsmartelectronics.com, Security Reports at security@shopsmartelectronics.com, and the Data Protection Officer at dpo@shopsmartelectronics.com. You can also call 1-800-746-7762, option 9, or write to ShopSmart Electronics, Attn: Privacy, 1200 Commerce Way, Springfield, IL 62701.

751709a91f60411c.query: Does ShopSmart sell my personal information to other companies or share it with advertisers in a way that identifies me?
751709a91f60411c.reference_answer: ShopSmart does not sell customer personal information and never shares data with third-party advertisers in a form that identifies an individual.

a7e7c9fc72c31b18.query: How long does ShopSmart Electronics keep my payment information on file?
a7e7c9fc72c31b18.reference_answer: ShopSmart Electronics retains payment data for 7 years. The stored information includes only the last four digits, card brand, and expiry date, never full card numbers.

e2fe13c7e436a6f1.query: I just got a fraud alert on my ShopSmart account and need to update my shipping address for an upcoming order. How long will I be blocked from making address or payment changes?
e2fe13c7e436a6f1.reference_answer: Address and payment changes are blocked for 72 hours after a fraud alert triggers Protected Status on your account.

b4bf189e3e0978bf.query: How many ShopSmart Points are needed to get $5.00 off a purchase, and can they be used to buy gift cards?
b4bf189e3e0978bf.reference_answer: 500 points are required for a $5.00 redemption, and points cannot be applied to gift card purchases.

71174d684697cb54.query: I'm using a buy-now-pay-later option at checkout — what personal details does ShopSmart share with the BNPL provider to set up my instalment plan?
71174d684697cb54.reference_answer: ShopSmart shares your name, email address, the order amount, and the order ID with the BNPL provider for the purpose of administering the instalment plan.

4ab7b1a0c180dbae.query: Can I use store credit together with another payment method when buying something?
4ab7b1a0c180dbae.reference_answer: Yes, store credit can be combined with other payment methods and is applied first.

462dc3d57653dd5f.query: If I return part of an order that used a promotional discount, how is the refund amount determined?
462dc3d57653dd5f.reference_answer: When an order with a promotional discount is partially returned, the discount is recalculated across the retained items. If the remaining order falls below the code's minimum purchase threshold, the discount is forfeited and the refund is reduced accordingly. The recalculation is shown on the refund confirmation.

796a0ccf3d30d393.query: What are the denominations and delivery time for digital gift cards purchased via email?
796a0ccf3d30d393.reference_answer: Digital gift cards can be purchased in any whole amount from $10 to $500 and are delivered within 15 minutes.

31e700f6f45b4f6f.query: I bought a bundle that includes a smartphone and headphones, but I only want to keep the headphones. What are my options?
31e700f6f45b4f6f.reference_answer: You must return the complete bundle and reorder the headphones at their individual price, or keep the entire bundle. The only exception is if a component is defective, in which case the defective item is replaced individually at no charge while you retain the rest of the bundle.

c048e4abfaa94f36.query: How long does standard shipping take and what is the cost for orders sent to Europe?
c048e4abfaa94f36.reference_answer: Standard shipping to Europe takes 7–14 business days and costs $14.99.

ac380e243bbd1a14.query: What happens if a customer refuses to pay customs duties on an international order from ShopSmart Electronics?
ac380e243bbd1a14.reference_answer: If the recipient refuses to pay customs duties, the package is either returned to ShopSmart or abandoned by the carrier. If returned, the item price is refunded in the original currency, but the original international shipping charge is not refunded and any return shipping costs are deducted from the refund. If the package is abandoned or destroyed by customs, no refund is issued.

336d48c2888d73a8.query: What is the cost and eligibility requirement for the Premium Business membership tier?
336d48c2888d73a8.reference_answer: The Premium Business tier costs $149.00 per year or $15.99 per month and requires a registered business tax ID for eligibility.

45944d94deba6815.query: I live in Australia and need help with an international order; what are the support hours in Eastern Standard Time and which contact method has a 4-hour response target for Premium Members?
45944d94deba6815.reference_answer: Support hours are Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST, and Sunday 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST. The asynchronous message centre carries a 4-hour response target for Premium Members.

43dcbc0d41789ed8.query: I have a category code for 12% off headphones; can I also apply a site-wide promo code on top of it?
43dcbc0d41789ed8.reference_answer: No. Category codes are not stackable with other promotions.

9c8e25953f6a3574.query: What happens if a backordered item's estimated availability date is delayed by more than 30 days?
9c8e25953f6a3574.reference_answer: ShopSmart notifies the customer and offers the choice of continuing to wait, substituting an equivalent product, or cancelling the backorder with no charge.

b3bbd3ea7f7acc55.query: What happens to my extended return window if my ShopSmart Protect membership lapses or is cancelled?
b3bbd3ea7f7acc55.reference_answer: When a membership lapses or is cancelled, extended return windows revert to standard windows immediately. A return initiated after the lapse date is evaluated under the standard window even if the order was placed during the active membership period.

cca40bf397908651.query: If I send back a 60-inch TV that I've already opened, will the refund be the full purchase price?
cca40bf397908651.reference_answer: No, a 15% restocking fee applies to opened televisions over 55 inches, so the refund would be reduced by that percentage.

d23c2349cdaecd57.query: I'm considering applying for the ShopSmart Financing Card and want to know what the standard revolving credit APR is after any promotional period ends.
d23c2349cdaecd57.reference_answer: The standard revolving credit APR after the promotional period is 26.99% variable.

acbda130742707ff.query: I placed an order as a guest and now want to cancel it. Can I do that through the guest lookup tool, or do I need to contact support?
acbda130742707ff.reference_answer: Guest lookup only shows status and tracking; cancellations require account access or a verified support call for identity verification. You can contact Order Support by phone at 1-800-746-7762 (option 2), email at orders@shopsmartelectronics.com, or live chat on the website or mobile app during support hours.

9bb54533757cdc1e.query: What are the contact details and hours for ShopSmart Electronics billing support?
9bb54533757cdc1e.reference_answer: Billing support can be reached by phone at 1-800-746-7762, option 3, or by email at billing@shopsmartelectronics.com. Support hours are Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST, and Sunday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST.

d0a1199385d6352d.query: I was charged twice for the same order and both charges have been posted and settled for more than 5 business days. How long will it take to get a refund once the duplicate is confirmed?
d0a1199385d6352d.reference_answer: Confirmed duplicate charges are refunded within 2 business days.

47c29808090c7781.query: If I pay with my ShopSmart store credit, how quickly will a refund show up back in my account?
47c29808090c7781.reference_answer: Refunds to ShopSmart Store Credit are processed instantly.

51507ecbdc069f90.query: As a Premium Member, how many days after my order arrives can I request a price match or a price adjustment?
51507ecbdc069f90.reference_answer: Premium Members have a 30-day window from the delivery date for both price matches and price adjustments.

0a0b7a7294c638c7.query: Does ShopSmart include mandatory shipping charges when comparing a competitor's price for a price match?
0a0b7a7294c638c7.reference_answer: Yes, the comparison price includes the item price plus any mandatory shipping charges, so a competitor item priced at $340.00 with $15.00 mandatory shipping is compared as $355.00 against a ShopSmart price that includes free shipping.

0cc3ea0f25ffb249.query: What is the price match window for a standard account?
0cc3ea0f25ffb249.reference_answer: The price match window for a standard account is 14 days from delivery.

ce4fda72098d47fc.query: I'm thinking about buying wireless headphones from the Audio & Headphones category. What is the return window and is there a restocking fee?
ce4fda72098d47fc.reference_answer: The return window for Audio & Headphones is 30 days and there is no restocking fee.

dabb98c7260be70a.query: What condition deduction applies to wearables with visible wear on the band or sensor surface?
dabb98c7260be70a.reference_answer: Visible wear on a band or sensor surface may trigger a 70% condition deduction.

9a271a95a6d495dd.query: I bought a laptop for in-store pickup on Monday, but it dropped in price on Wednesday. Does the 14-day price match window start on Monday or Wednesday?
9a271a95a6d495dd.reference_answer: For in-store pickup orders, the price match window is measured from the pickup date, so it would start on Monday.

e8e755c324d6b477.query: Which product category does a gaming headset belong to?
e8e755c324d6b477.reference_answer: A gaming headset belongs to the Gaming Accessories category, not Audio & Headphones.

977dc065c0a5ec27.query: Can I return a digital code or software purchase if I change my mind?
977dc065c0a5ec27.reference_answer: Software and digital codes are non-returnable.

0974c0cc72159f06.query: What is the return shipping cost for a non-defective large item like a TV over 40 inches?
0974c0cc72159f06.reference_answer: For non-defective large items such as TVs over 40 inches, a $29.95 fee is deducted from the refund for scheduled pickup.

88298beb0217222f.query: How long does it take to get a refund when I paid with a buy-now-pay-later service?
88298beb0217222f.reference_answer: Refunds for Buy Now Pay Later purchases are processed within 7 to 14 business days.

82ee2b3ca580b766.query: What is the return period for a game console or handheld system, and what condition must be met for the return to be accepted?
82ee2b3ca580b766.reference_answer: Game consoles and handheld systems have a 15-day return window, and the serial number on the unit must match the order record for the return to be accepted.

f6dea49b68243722.query: What does the ShopSmart Protect plan cover and what are the costs for claims?
f6dea49b68243722.reference_answer: ShopSmart Protect extends coverage for one or two extra years past the manufacturer's warranty and includes accidental damage protection for drops, spills, and cracked screens. The first claim has no deductible, while later claims require a $50 deductible, and shipping for warranty repairs is free.

2c7b67543018d3b2.query: I returned an item I bought with PayPal; how many business days will it take for the refund to appear in my account?
2c7b67543018d3b2.reference_answer: Refunds to PayPal are processed within 3–5 business days.

72e92df00eeecd82.query: I'm looking at a product on ShopSmart Electronics and want to know what determines its return window, restocking fee, loyalty point multiplier, and shipping restrictions. What should I check first?
72e92df00eeecd82.reference_answer: You should first determine the product's category assignment, as this determines the applicable return window, restocking fee, loyalty point multiplier, and shipping restrictions according to the Product Category Reference Guide.

32524aa95b6c45a2.query: I've returned several items to ShopSmart over the past year and I'm worried my account might get flagged. What specific return behaviors does ShopSmart consider as indicators of return abuse that could lead to account suspension?
32524aa95b6c45a2.reference_answer: ShopSmart considers the following as indicators of return abuse: an excessive return rate (more than 40% of orders returned over a 12-month period), patterns of returning used items as unopened, serial number mismatches, and returns of counterfeit or substituted items. Accounts flagged for return abuse may be suspended pending review.

14e4beefba925aea.query: When does ShopSmart stop guaranteeing next-day and same-day premium delivery around the holidays?
14e4beefba925aea.reference_answer: Next-Day and Premium Same-Day shipping guarantees are suspended from December 18 to December 26 due to carrier capacity constraints.

efc18583e5f39cbd.query: What is the return window for laptops and computers, and what condition must they be in?
efc18583e5f39cbd.reference_answer: The return window for laptops and computers is 30 days, and they must be in their original packaging with all accessories included.

1c65cb310c810a82.query: Can a gift recipient initiate a return on an order placed by someone else?
1c65cb310c810a82.reference_answer: No, a gift recipient cannot initiate a return on an order placed by someone else because returns must be initiated by the account that placed the order, as the refund flows back to the original payment method.

37a427952fddc87c.query: I bought a pair of headphones on December 1st. When is the last day I can return them under the holiday return policy?
37a427952fddc87c.reference_answer: The effective expiry date for Audio & Headphones purchased on December 1st is January 31st, as the standard 30-day return window is extended to January 31st during the holiday period.

4b378719fa07575d.query: I placed a store pickup order for an in-stock item at ShopSmart Electronics. How long will it take to be ready, how will I be notified, and what happens if I don't pick it up within a week?
4b378719fa07575d.reference_answer: Your order will be ready within 2 hours for in-stock items, and you'll receive an email notification when it's ready. Orders not picked up within 7 days will be cancelled and refunded.

a07bf92226907fbf.query: What is the cost and estimated delivery time for the Premium Same-Day shipping option?
a07bf92226907fbf.reference_answer: The Premium Same-Day shipping option costs $34.99 and offers same-day delivery in metro areas only.

cccb9604468d870f.query: Does ShopSmart provide a service where they bring big appliances or big-screen TVs inside my house, unpack them, do a basic installation, and take away the boxes?
cccb9604468d870f.reference_answer: Yes, ShopSmart offers White Glove Delivery for select large items such as televisions over 55 inches, home theater systems, and large appliances. The service includes a scheduled 4-hour delivery window, in-home delivery to the room of your choice, unboxing and basic setup, and removal of all packaging materials for a fee of $79.99 in most metro areas.

388504eced51f194.query: I have a ShopSmart Protect Basic plan and my laptop needs an out-of-warranty repair; can I get a loaner device while it's being fixed?
388504eced51f194.reference_answer: No. Loaner devices are available only to ShopSmart Protect Plus customers and are not provided under Protect Basic, the Standard Warranty, or for out-of-warranty repairs.

285eae0a5d95123d.query: If I paid with PayPal, how will my in-store refund be issued and how long will it take?
285eae0a5d95123d.reference_answer: The refund will be issued back to your PayPal account and typically takes 3–5 business days to process.
